text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright……。

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Special Week-sama was magnificent. Speed in final stretch, 
tenacity never yielding lead……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
……I struck with every ounce of power held. 
Yet failed to reach…… Uuu…… could not catch her……！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright really takes after me, huh……？ 
Depth of frustration is identical.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's why…… legs can still run. 
No way you give up after getting this far.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Let's keep running together, from here on too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ……Uwaaaaaaa~! Ryan-oneesamaaaa~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Fufu……good run, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
All right, victory photo with winning team！ 
Special Week-san, take center please！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, desu！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What, gettin' cold feet now? 
Straighten up or moment's wasted, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl with Straight-cut Bangs
text_block_list.text: Exactly！ You just won G1 race, after all！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know, but with this many eyes on me, 
calming down is tricky, desu~……。

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Maintain confidence shown throughout. 
Just as displayed during race, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you looked super cool……！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ……Feels like I moved one step closer, desu.
Closer to becoming "Japan's #1 Uma Musume"?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes. During Derby, focus was only on self. 
"Must win no matter what", thought only of that……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ran with full strength today too, 
but…… heard them clearly.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
On final stretch, exact moment maximum effort was needed, 
voices of everyone cheering……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Saw faces too. Faces of everyone here, 
who would be happiest to see victory……！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, while running and after crossing goal, 
never felt alone. Reassuring feeling……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hard to express in words, 
but to become "Japan's #1 Uma Musume", 
that feeling is crucial, desu.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just like today's run and path ahead, 
"Japan's #1 Uma Musume" title lies straight forward.
Girl who arrived in Tokyo from countryside――

Girl constantly talking about grand dream of "Japan's #1"――
before realized, dream reached within arm's grasp.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, squeeze in close
so everyone fits in frame!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Spe! Strike pose fit for "Japan's #1 Uma Musume"!
You better deliver!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: P-Pose...!? Ah, um... um...!?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Alright, here we go~... Big smiles, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'll become! Japan's number one~!
With ringing voice, Special Week proclaimed dream.

In response to girl bearing so many
expectations, stands erupted in deafening roar.
